summary: Putting an empty slice into a zero-capacity BytesMut enters allocation reuse and calls copy_to_bytes(0), which creates another zero-capacity BytesMut and calls put again. This recurses indefinitely and overflows the stack. The fix returns immediately when the source has no remaining bytes. The fix-added test test_bytes_mut_reuse in tests/test_buf_mut.rs exercises this case. Both reversal regions occur exactly once; replacing the fixed region restores the entire implementation file to its parent version. No tests were run.
